answer: The zephyr cap is policed at intake and dawn publishes the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a harbor tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
